# Pulaski County, Kentucky Genealogy

## County Background

Pulaski County was established on December 10, 1798, from [Lincoln](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Lincoln_County,_Kentucky_Genealogy) and [Green](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Green_County,_Kentucky_Genealogy) counties. The county seat is [Somerset](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Somerset,_Kentucky). Named for Kazimierz Pułaski, a Polish soldier who served in the American Revolution, the county is located in the south-central area of the state.

## Record Availability

| **Record Type** | **Earliest Date** |
| --- | --- |
| Birth | 1852 |
| Marriage | 1799 |
| Death | 1852 |
| Court | 1799 |
| Land | 1799 |
| Probate | 1801 |
| Census | 1810 |

## Record Losses

A disaster destroyed some records in 1838 and again in 1871.

## Key Repositories

- **Pulaski County Courthouse** — 100 N. Main Street, #208, Somerset, KY 42502. Holds marriage bonds, deeds, court orders, and wills from county formation.
- **Pulaski County Historical Society** — maintains vertical files on each Pulaski County surname and holds the most comprehensive collection of church records and obituaries from local newspapers.
- **Kentucky Department for Libraries and Archives (KDLA)** — holds microfilmed copies of many county records.

## Online Resources

- **FamilySearch** — early will books (1801–1929) have been digitized; marriage bonds and consent forms from 1799–1871 are available.
- **Ancestry** — county tax lists, census records, and vital records indexes.
